# GitHub Copilot adapter

Before any work, read and follow `AGENTS.md`. Then read every applicable canonical rule in `.agents/rules/`; each rule states its own scope.

`docs/project/source-of-truth.md` identifies authoritative project documents.
Do not copy repository policy into this adapter and do not infer current state from tool-specific files under `.claude/`, `.codex/`, or `.cursor/`.
